metadata.title: Magnetized  Unified RMF Equation of State for Cold Neutron Star
metadata.description:
Unified outer crust+ inner crust + core equation of state for magnetized npe beta-equilibrated matter, calculated within the RMF formalism using the NL3wr model [1,2]. We consider magnetic field between 10^16 G and 10^18 G.

The outer crust was calculated using the tool [3].

The file NL3wr_magnetized_outer+inner+core_AMM.txt is calculated including the contribution of the anomalous magnetic moment of the nucleons, while the file NL3wr_magnetized_outer+inner+core.txt does not include that contribution.

Each file is composed of 11 columns which contain, in order:

1) The magnetic field in G

2) The total number density (nucleons + electrons) in fm^-3

3) The total energy density in fm^-4

4) The component of the total pressure parallel to the magnetic field in fm^-4

5) The baryonic chemical potential in MeV

6) The mesonic field contribution to the pressure in fm^-4

7) The baryonic contribution to the parallel component of the pressure in fm^-4

8) The baryonic number density in fm^-3

9) The squared speed of sound

10) The component of the total pressure normal to the magnetic field in fm^-4

11) The total magnetization divided by the magnetic field

 

[1] C. J. Horowitz and J. Piekarewicz, Phys. Rev. Lett. 86, 5647 (2001); Phys. Rev. C 64, 062802 (2001).

[2] H. Pais and C. Providência, Phys. Rev. C 94, 015808 (2016).

[3] N. Chamel, Equilibrium structure of the outer crust of a magnetar (Version 1.0.0). Zenodo. http://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3839787, (2020).
references: C. J. Horowitz and J. Piekarewicz, Phys. Rev. Lett. 86, 5647 (2001); Phys. Rev. C 64, 062802 (2001).
H. Pais and C. Providência, Phys. Rev. C 94, 015808 (2016).
N. Chamel, Equilibrium structure of the outer crust of a magnetar (Version 1.0.0). Zenodo. http://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3839787, (2020).

metadata.title: Unified Relativistic Mean Field EoSs with density dependent couplings
metadata.description:
This dataset, containing 447345 equations of state, was used or the Bayesian analysis on the 
properties of Neutron Stars in [1]. Each EoS includes an outer crust, an inner crust and a core.
The outer crust used for all the EoSs is the BsK22[2], while each pair of inner crust and core was calculated
using the same Relativistic Mean Field model and a Compressible Liquid Drop approximation for the 
clusters in the inner crust. The crust-core transition is determined for each model by the crossing
of the energy density of crust and core.

[1] L. Scurto, H. Pais and F. Gulminelli, arXiv:2402.15548 (2024)
[2] J.M. Pearson, N. Chamel, A.Y. Potekhin, A.F. Fantina, C. Ducoin, A.K. Dutta, and S. Goriely, MNRAS 481, 2994 (2018)
references: L. Scurto, H. Pais and F. Gulminelli, arXiv:2402.15548 (2024)
J.M. Pearson, N. Chamel, A.Y. Potekhin, A.F. Fantina, C. Ducoin, A.K. Dutta, and S. Goriely, MNRAS 481, 2994 (2018)
